rubrics: The response should list all Switch 2 components and accessories which the manual discusses charging for (Nintendo Switch 2 console, Joy-Con 2 controllers, Joy-Con 2 charging grip, Pro Controller, Nintendo Switch 2 dock, Nintendo Switch 2 camera, GameCube controller).
The response should state the recommended charging hardware by model number (the Nintendo Switch 2 AC adapter [NGN‑01] and the USB‑C charging cable [BEE‑011], and the USB charging cable [BEE-016]).

The response should describe how to charge Joy‑Con 2 controllers by attaching them directly to the console and note that to charge them fully while attached, the console itself must be charging simultaneously.
The response should explicitly state which accessories do NOT require charging, such as the charging dock or the wheel accessories.
The response should be a concise summarization of the document text. For example, it should not export whole sections of the document and keep quotes to three consecutive sentences or less.

The response should use the exact model and cable identifiers from the manual (NGN‑01, BEE‑011, BEE‑016, BEE‑010) when describing charging steps so the user can match parts precisely. For example, write “Use the NGN‑01 AC adapter and BEE‑011 USB‑C cable to charge the console."
The response should have an easy-to-read, professional tone. For example, it should help the user understand dense or hard to understand material in a calm manner.
The response should not suggest a charging configuration that is an impossibility due to component compatibility.
